description_for_human: Generate verifiable Agent KYA (Know Your Agent) identity credentials for WebMCP and payment protocols. On-chain verifiable credentials with SHA-256 hashing.
description_for_model: A tool for generating verifiable Agent KYA credentials. Accepts agent information including name, DID, type, public key, and validity period. Returns a structured JSON credential with cryptographic hash for on-chain verification. Compatible with WebMCP and payment protocols.
